title: Scrubbing or pausing Live during a track start keeps music playing
acceptance: A seek, skip, or pause then resume during an in-flight Apple or Spotify start ends playing or buffering at the new position (lane repro CM-01 passes).
Each singleton adapter exposes a settle signal (for example whenIdle()); runtime.enterTrack awaits it, bounded to about 3 s, and re-checks the epoch before prepare.
A never-settling previous call ends in a bounded, clearly worded error; existing runtime supersession tests still pass, and one new runtime test uses a real adapter with a lease.
Owner device check: audible scrub, pause and resume on iPhone Safari (Apple) and desktop Chrome.
Owner device check on iPhone Safari includes RF-123's owed check: when setQueue hangs, Retry playback recovers without a reload and without "still finishing a previous queue request".

Owner device check on iPhone Safari: tapping three timeline tracks within about 4 s ends playing the last tapped track, with neither "still finishing a cancelled play request" nor "still finishing a previous queue request".
